title: Resizer
summary: A handle on a panel's edge that changes the panel's width by a drag, the keyboard or a double click back to the default, within limits; optionally remembered in the browser.

min.description: The narrowest width, a CSS length (tokens and percentages of the panel's parent too).

max.description: The widest width, a CSS length.

property.description: A CSS custom property the width is written to on the target; empty writes inline-size.

target.description: A selector of the closest ancestor that is the panel; empty is the parent.

step.description: Pixels an arrow key moves; Shift moves four steps.

storage-key.description: Remembers the width in this browser as the view preference sf-resizer/<key> (SF.Preferences); a double click forgets it.

label.description: The accessible name; defaults to the page language's «Resize».

value.description: A width in pixels the host keeps (a person's settings); it wins over the browser's memory.

attach.description: SF.Resizer.attach(root, {handles, session(handle) -> {measure, limits, apply, commit, reset, direction, step, start, end}}) gives any edge -- a table's column edges -- the same drag, keys, double click, cursor and separator value.

sf-resize.summary: The width changed: while dragging (move), after a drag or a key (end), or back to the stylesheet's width (reset).

width.description: The width the person dragged to, in CSS pixels, clamped to min and max when it is applied.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the width on a server

accessibility.focus: The handle is in the tab order with role separator, aria-orientation vertical and aria-valuenow/min/max in pixels. Arrows change the width by a step (Shift: four), Home and End set a limit, Enter, Space and a double click restore the stylesheet's width.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-resizer when a person should widen or narrow a panel, a menu column or a side area by its edge. Put it inside the panel; give min and max; write the width to the variable the panel's stylesheet reads.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not rely on pointer dragging alone; keep the keyboard path
Do not save the width on a server from the component; listen to sf-resize
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <nav style="inline-size: var(--menu-width, 16rem)"><sf-resizer min="13rem" max="24rem" property="--menu-width" storage-key="menu" label="Menu width"></sf-resizer></nav>
